Free number merge games, in your browser
Small number games with one goal. Slide, drop, link, sort, fit, pop, spin, fuse, jump, push, skate, dial, bend, fold, sow, hop, mirror, match, drift, route, bracket, ricochet, feed, flip, balance, drive, shoot or steer your numbers until one of them reads 4096.
Every game on 4096x has the same goal: build a 4096. In every game two matching numbers merge into their double, so 2 and 2 make 4 and 2048 and 2048 make 4096. Each game gets there its own way: sliding tiles, dropping blocks, linking chains, sorting balls, fitting pieces, popping groups, spinning a hexagon, fusing numbers round a ring, jumping twins like a knight, pushing tiles into their twins, skating tiles across the ice, turning the rings of a dial, bending paths between twins, folding the board like paper, sowing stacks round a loop of pits, hopping tiles over their twins, mirroring every move across the board, matching shelf tiles into a tray, letting the wind drift tiles into their twins, routing balls through flipping switches, seeding numbers into a tournament bracket, banking tiles off mirrors, feeding tiles onto conveyor belts, flipping stacks of pancakes, balancing numbers on a beam, driving cars into their twins through a jammed car park, shooting bubbles or steering a snake.
Every game is free, needs no sign-up and runs in any modern browser on a phone, tablet or computer. New here? Start with Classic and work your way through the rest. Popular, Easy and Hard come from how often each game is played and how often players build 4096 in it, counted without names or accounts.
